name: DeleteContact
label: Delete Salesforce Contact
description: Deletes an existing Contact record in Salesforce by its ID.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.label: Contact ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Contact to delete (required).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after deletion.
